Velvaa makes gentle, fragrance-free essentials inspired by ingredients our grandmothers trusted, like saffron and rice water, reformulated for modern routines and humid Indian weather.

Velvaa started in a small Jaipur kitchen with one question: why do simple, familiar ingredients feel so hard to find in modern skincare? Every Velvaa product is made in India, free from added fragrance, and designed to fit into a three-step routine you'll actually keep.
We're a small team, and we'd rather tell you exactly what's in the bottle than make promises skin can't keep.
Anyone who wants a short, gentle routine, especially if you live somewhere hot and humid and dislike heavy, sticky products.
We are currently working on third-party certification and will share details once it is complete.
